principles: No advertising while a profile is loading.
No advertising inside dense Brawler guide reading.
No unexpected full-screen interstitial on app launch.
No ad after every click or navigation action.
Use frequency caps and natural transition points.
Rewarded ads, if introduced, must always be explicit opt-in and never required for core guide access.
complianceNotes: Ad providers and consent tooling must be selected before enabling monetization.
Actual privacy disclosures and store Data Safety/App Privacy declarations must match the final SDK behavior.
Fan Content Policy restrictions apply to advertising content as well as the app itself.
